baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً binds sender, carrier, voiced following, written sheets, and removed contamination.
baseline_models.mechanism: The envoy carries speech from God, recitation follows an antecedent textual order, and purification closes the sheet-specific failure mode of confused reading. The ayah presents controlled transfer across source, messenger, voice, and page.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and message join the carrier to the carried speech as one transmission link.
The fixed divine name anchors the chain's stated origin.
Following in sequence makes the voiced act track an ordered antecedent.
Written sheets provide the durable material record being orally followed.
Misreading from confused letters supplies the sheet-specific error channel that purity excludes.
Defilement removed marks the transmitted textual object as clean of contaminating defect.

changed_reading.after: A sender-to-page-to-voice chain transfers divine speech under a textual-integrity guarantee.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَسُولٌ and يَتْلُوا۟ both carry movement and succession, while صُحُفًا is plural.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dispatch, deliberate pace, successive batches, and following order make revelation an unfolding delivery. The messenger does not merely possess a finished object; purified written units are released and voiced in sequence.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies the outward launch of the delivery.
Deliberate unhurried recitation sets the delivery's controlled pace.
Successive batches give the plural sheets a serial release pattern.
Following in sequence orders each voiced unit after what precedes it.
The plural written sheets are the discrete units carried through the sequence.
Purity keeps each released unit free of defect across the sequence.

changed_reading.before: The messenger reads from a completed corpus.
changed_reading.after: The messenger deliberately releases and voices purified written units in ordered succession.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُّطَهَّرَةً directly marks the sheets as purified, while the ط ه ر inventory also contains a medium pure in itself that purifies another.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive adjective first describes a received state, but its branch field leaves open a second function: pages already purified can become a purifying medium when dispatched into recitation, cleansing conduct rather than remaining a sealed clean object.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch moves the purified object outward into contact with recipients.
Voiced following supplies the act through which the medium reaches listeners.
A medium pure in itself and able to purify another supplies the active-transfer possibility.
Cleansing self and conduct identifies the possible recipient-side effect.

changed_reading.before: Purity is only a static property of the pages.
changed_reading.after: The purified pages may function, through recitation, as a medium that purifies the recipient's conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior scene supplies truth under cover, an entanglement that can be opened, and evidence becoming manifest. Reciting purified sheets therefore becomes an operative disclosure: it removes obstruction and separates what had been locked together.

activation_trace.role: Ordered recitation is the focus act assigned the work of disclosure.
The purifying medium supplies an active remover rather than a merely clean object.
Concealment of truth supplies the epistemic obstruction facing the recitation.
Opening what is closed and separating what is entangled supplies the release operation.
Manifestation and uncovering define the evidence as a transition into visibility.

structural_cues: 98:1 ends with the evidence's arrival, and 98:2 immediately supplies the messenger-recitation scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, opening, and manifestation; I infer that recitation is the operative opening. A live alternative is that the evidence is the messenger as a whole, with the sheets only its content.

changed_reading.after: The recitation actively uncovers concealed truth and unfastens a settled entanglement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sheets become an outer purified collection containing joined writings that can establish binding determinations. Their uprightness makes the collection an internally ordered, norm-maintaining architecture rather than undifferentiated sacred material.

activation_trace.role: Collected sheets supply the outer textual container.
Removed defect marks the container's organizing content as uncontaminated.
Joining one thing to another makes the inner writings an assembled structure.
A binding determination gives the assembled writings normative force.
Uprightness and evenness supply the inner system's stable alignment.

structural_cues: 98:3 uses the container relation فِيهَا: writings are located within the focus ayah's sheets.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies containment, joining, binding, and uprightness; I infer an organized normative system inside the sheets. Alternatively, قَيِّمَةٌ may praise the writings' rectitude or value without assigning them a maintaining function.

changed_reading.before: The purified sheets are simply documents recited.
changed_reading.after: The sheets are a purified container whose joined, binding writings form an upright normative architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purification and manifestation draw a clean boundary. Once the recited evidence arrives, latent differences can become distinguishable and then socially scattered, so maximal clarity need not produce consensus.

activation_trace.role: Removal of admixture supplies the focus image of a sharpened boundary.
Separation and distinction make the evidence boundary-forming as well as revealing.
Manifestation supplies the clarity that exposes the boundary.
Scattering into parts supplies the social result that follows disclosure.
After-versus-before ordering places the division subsequent to the evidence.
Arrival makes disclosure a dated event across which the social state changes.

structural_cues: 98:4 orders social division after the evidence's arrival, not before it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, afterwardness, distinction, scattering, and manifestation; I infer that disclosure makes latent differences actionable. A live alternative is that 'after' is temporal only and people divide despite, not because of, the evidence.

changed_reading.before: Purified clarity removes ambiguity and therefore tends toward agreement.
changed_reading.after: Purified clarity can expose boundaries so sharply that previously latent disagreement becomes overt division.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pages' purity migrates into a commanded practice: ordered following becomes submitted worship, purification after admixture becomes exclusive orientation, and purity becomes growth enacted through giving. Textual cleanliness is thus realized as a disciplined life.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence lets recitation become a pattern for behavioral following.
A medium that purifies another supplies transfer from pages to practitioners.
Cleansed self and conduct define the intended practical result.
Demand and obligation convert the recited writings into required action.
Worship as submissive obedience supplies the posture of enactment.
Purity after admixture mirrors the sheets' cleansing at the level of orientation.
Exclusive separation from association gives the purified practice a single direction.
Growth and increase make purification productive rather than merely subtractive.
Purity and soundness echo the focus adjective in an enacted social duty.

structural_cues: 98:5 converts the preceding writings into a restricted command sequence of worship, prayer-establishment, and giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, submitted worship, purification after mixture, and purity with growth; I infer a causal pipeline from recitation to practice. Alternatively, 98:5 may only state the writings' duties without making the pages themselves a purifying agent.

changed_reading.before: The pages are pure content delivered to an audience.
changed_reading.after: The recited pages are a program whose purity is realized as exclusive worship and productive, cleansing practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later truth-covering and adhesive persistence limit the active-purifier baseline. The sheets can expose and offer cleansing, but reception is not automatic; a hearer can remain attached to concealment.

activation_trace.role: The purifying medium is the focus possibility whose automatic efficacy is being limited.
Continued concealment of truth supplies resistant non-uptake after disclosure.
Adhesion and abiding supply persistence in the consequence of that refusal.

structural_cues: 98:6 repeats the book-community and associator categories after the recitation and commands, assigning some to enduring fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continued truth-covering and adherence; I infer that exposure to purified pages is resistible. Alternatively, 98:6 may classify different members than those who received the recitation, so it limits rather than disproves purifying efficacy.

changed_reading.before: Hearing the purified pages is itself enough to purify recipients.
changed_reading.after: The pages offer purification without coercing uptake; listeners may remain attached to concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispatch expands into a living circuit. Lordly nurture opens a channel, an envoy-like flow carries ongoing provision outward, and reciprocal acceptance supplies a return movement; the recited purified sheets become a conduit joining divine source, sustaining transmission, and responsive recipients.

activation_trace.role: Sending forth supplies the circuit's outward movement from the divine source.
Reciprocal sending and matching leave the dispatch open to a returning response.
The purifying medium identifies what the transmission carries through the circuit.
Nurture, repair, and completion define the source-side purpose of the flow.
The running agent as envoy explicitly links flow imagery back to the focus messenger.
Ongoing provision makes the transmitted flow sustaining rather than momentary.
Opening and widening until flow supplies the conduit mechanism.
Mutual acceptance supplies the responsive return that closes the relational circuit.

structural_cues: 98:8 moves from reward at their Lord, through flowing rivers, to reciprocal رضى, reversing agent and recipient around God and the people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, envoy-like flow, ongoing provision, opened channels, nurture, and mutual acceptance; I map the reward scene's outward flow back onto the focus transmission and infer a return response. Alternatively, the rivers may describe reward only and mutual رضى an outcome rather than a communication mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A messenger performs one-way delivery of a clean document.
changed_reading.after: The messenger-recitation is an opened, nurturing conduit whose purified flow elicits a response and culminates in reciprocal acceptance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dominant ت ل و mapping supports following and recitation, while the activation uses the packet's non-dominant ت ل ل split. It remains anchored through root_000185/B004, the focus object 'written sheets,' and 98:4's explicit giving image; downstream prose should render it only as a form-distant material echo, never as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَتْلُوا۟ directly governs صُحُفًا, while the split mapped inventory offers an image of pouring or handing over.

activation_trace.role: Carrier and carried message keep the material handover attached to the messenger scene.
The non-dominant split branch contributes pouring or handing into a recipient's hand.
Written sheets provide the concrete object imagined as handed over.
Giving supplies a recipient-facing transfer that strengthens the handover image.

changed_reading.before: The messenger only voices the purified sheets.
changed_reading.after: At a contained material level, the voicing can be pictured as pouring forth or handing purified sheets into recipients' keeping.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain image is surprising because it activates صَحفة, a broad shallow basin, inside the ص ح ف inventory and joins it to later river flow. It remains anchored to the focus noun and purifying adjective, but downstream prose should present it strictly as a material analogy for reception and distribution, not as the ordinary sense of صُحُف.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صُحُفًا and مُّطَهَّرَةً permit a branch-level analogy between a broad receiving surface and a purifying medium.

activation_trace.role: The broad shallow dish or basin supplies a receiving and distributing surface.
The purifying medium supplies what the basin-like surface receives and conveys.
Running and streaming supply movement through the imagined receiving surface.
Opening a channel until it flows supplies distribution beyond the surface.

changed_reading.before: The sheets are flat textual objects carrying purified content.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the sheets become broad receiving surfaces that gather and distribute a purifying flow.

strongest_changes: Purity moved from a static property of pages to a resistible operation: recitation can uncover, disentangle, and reform without coercing uptake.
The plural sheets became an ordered container of joined, binding, upright writings rather than an undifferentiated document.
Clarity acquired a double effect: it exposes truth yet may sharpen boundaries into overt division.
Final flow and reciprocal-acceptance cues recast one-way dispatch as a living transmission circuit.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah binds person, voice, page, and purification into one transfer mechanism; context repeatedly changes what that purity does while leaving the same focus anchors intact.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive form مُّطَهَّرَةً directly asserts received purity; its use as an actively purifying medium remains exploratory.
The temporal 'after' in 98:4 does not by itself decide whether evidence causes division or is resisted despite its clarity.
The flow-channel model may belong only to the reward scene rather than describing revelation's mechanics.
The ت ل ل handover and صَحفة basin activations are packet-backed but intentionally form-distant.
